fixes.what: BLOCKING. Northern Burma down to Tagaung (the Yuan province of Zhengmian) was Yuan land until 4 April 1303, but this dossier never holds it. The mongol-empire dossier hands it over in 1293, the found region (Cliopatria's 1294 shape, about 0.4 percent of Myanmar) leaves it out, and no 1303 event marks the withdrawal. The Second Mongol invasion of Burma (1300-1303) is not among the wars.
fixes.why: First Mongol invasion of Burma (opened by the reviewer): the infobox says 'Northern Burma to Tagaung added to the Yuan dynasty'; 'The Mongols continued to occupy northern Burma to Tagaung as the province of Zhengmian (Cheng-Mien)'; 'on 4 April 1303, the Mongols abolished the province of Zhengmian (Cheng-Mien)', 'evacuated Tagaung, and returned to Yunnan'; the 'second invasion in 1300-1301' failed. mongol-empire /ledger/86 (1284-02 gain from pagan-kingdom, c3, region Pagan 1285 shape within the box 92-100 E, 23.5-27 N, 'northern Burma to Tagaung, the province of Zhengmian') is never lost, and mongol-empire /ledger/93 dissolves into this dossier. myinsaing-kingdom /ledger/1 and /ledger/2 (contest 1300-01 to 1303-04, Singu and Male, c3) and /ledger/3 (1303 gain of Upper Burma) all name yuan-dynasty, and this dossier has no mirror for any of them.
fixes.fix: Add the First Mongol invasion of Burma page to sources[]. Union the mongol-empire /ledger/86 region into the found region and into the 1294 and 1352 corrections. fixes.what: Wrong belligerents and missing zones. The war against Kaidu lists ilkhanate and golden-horde as the Yuan's enemies and leaves out Kaidu's ogedeid-ulus. Its zones are empty although the ogedeid-ulus dossier draws a contested zone against yuan-dynasty in the Altai and western Mongolia until 1301.

fixes.fix: Set the belligerents to yuan-dynasty, ogedeid-ulus and chagatai-khanate (Duwa). Set the zone to the union of the Altai and Western Mongolia. Add contest_start 1294 and contest_end 1301, counterpart ogedeid-ulus, with that zone. Keep 1304 (the western khans' recognition) as the war's end or end it at 1301, and say which in the note.
